# Lobs = integrate observed fluxes with no BB fit
# L+BB = observed flux + BB fit extrapolation
# See logL-obs_sn1999br_UBVRIz.txt and logL-bb_sn1999br_UBVRIz.txt for simple LC files
# Methodology:
# filters used:UBVRIz
# redshift used:0.00429
# extinction used:0.024

# BB fit below 1A suppressed by factor (lamda/1)^0
